USDCAD 1.3995 has no packeted REER, PPP, terms-of-trade or historical-z anchor, and AU/EA/JP/NZ rates RV are unmarked or unmarkable; with a flat book that is not a convergence setup.

vol-convexity.invalidation: NO_TRADE is invalidated only if a later packet supplies a trusted listed rates or eligible US/CA/AU/EA/JP option mark covering the event window, or if both central-bank events have printed and the residual is a slow spot-rates trend with no remaining binary. Until then any new spot OPEN remains the inferior expression. All contract levels stay null; none are invented.
vol-convexity.thesis: Fed/BoC event week makes timing the risk, so a linear spot expression in UST 10Y or SOFR is the wrong payoff while the book is flat. VIX 19.03 and oil at 103 are cross-asset facts, not substitute marks for rates or eligible-G10 implieds, and the packet has no trusted listed option prices, strikes, or expiries. Last-resort bounded-risk options would dominate spot if they could be marked; they cannot, so this seat stays out rather than invent a contract or chase spot.
